privacy.en:
Effective October 7, 2026. BatchMise 1.0 · Hailink Labs.

Local recipes and preparation records

Ingredients, weight-based recipes, plans, batch snapshots, weighing confirmations, uncertainty notes and history are stored locally on your device. Hailink Labs does not receive your recipes or preparation records. No app account, advertising, tracking, analytics SDK, developer backend or automatic cloud synchronization is used.

Apple purchases and access

Apple processes the optional 7-day Trial, Lifetime purchase and restoration through StoreKit. Verified access is cached in the app-only device Keychain. Business backups do not contain purchase credentials or grant access. Initial claims, purchases and restoration may require Apple connectivity. No camera, microphone, contacts, location or tracking permission is requested.

Files, backups and sharing

You choose where to export PDF, CSV or full JSON backups and which file to restore. A cloud provider selected in Files handles the file under its own policy; this is not automatic BatchMise synchronization. Backups contain readable recipe and run data and are not claimed to be encrypted. Protect private recipes and review files before sharing.

Retention and deletion

The app retains up to seven valid local backups and deleted records in Trash for 30 days. Settings offers restoration and deletion. Clearing local data also clears internal backups; external exports remain wherever you saved or shared them. Device loss or uninstalling can lose local records without an external backup. Restore Purchase restores access, not recipe files.
privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月7日。BatchMise 1.0 · Hailink Labs。

本地配方与备料记录

原料、重量制配方、计划、批次快照、称量确认、不确定说明及历史保存在设备本地。Hailink Labs 不接收配方或备料记录。无 App 账号、广告、追踪、分析 SDK、开发者后台或自动云同步。

Apple 购买与权益

Apple 通过 StoreKit 处理可选的7天试用、Lifetime 和恢复购买。验证权益缓存在 App 专属设备 Keychain，业务备份不包含购买凭证，也不能解锁权益。首次领取、购买和恢复可能需要连接 Apple。不请求相机、麦克风、通讯录、位置或追踪权限。

文件、备份与分享

PDF、CSV、完整 JSON 备份的导出位置和恢复文件由你选择。Files 中选择的云服务按自身政策处理文件，这不是 BatchMise 自动同步。备份包含可读取的配方及执行记录，不宣称加密。请保护私有配方并在分享前检查内容。

保留与删除

最多保留七份有效本机备份，回收站保留删除记录30天。Settings 提供恢复和删除。清空本机数据也清除内部备份，外部导出文件仍保留在你保存或分享的位置。没有外部备份时，丢失设备或卸载可能导致本地记录丢失。恢复购买恢复权益，不恢复配方文件。

support.en:
Plan and prepare batches

Add ingredients and your own tested weight-based recipe in Recipes. Create a Run with target yields and your tested batch limits. Review the split and totals before starting. Open each batch and confirm each ingredient only after weighing and preparing it for that batch. Confirmation does not mean added or mixed.

Interruptions and uncertainty

Mark Uncertain whenever the physical situation is unclear. The batch stays on Hold until you physically check and resolve it or cancel the batch. After restarting, an active run becomes Paused and asks for verification. Never repeat an addition based solely on an app record. Cancelling a batch keeps its quantity separate from prepared output.

History and files

Completed runs retain recipe and quantity snapshots. Repeat creates a new Draft with fresh pending checks. Export PDF or CSV from results, or a full JSON backup from Settings. Full restore replaces local business data after validation and a backup; it does not merge databases or restore purchase access. Save important backups outside this device.

Trial and Lifetime

The fictional Demo stays free. You choose when to claim the free non-consumable 7-day Trial; it lasts 7 × 24 hours from the first verified Apple transaction and never renews or charges automatically. Lifetime is a US$19.99 one-time non-consumable purchase in the United States. After trial expiry, new real runs require Lifetime; already started runs and saved-data retrieval remain available. Settings → Trial, Lifetime & Restore Purchase contains purchase and restoration controls.

Scope and help

V1 supports g/kg ingredient weights and piece or gram yields. It does not convert cups or ingredient density, read a scale, provide recipes, guarantee baking results or certify food safety. For help, include app version, action and exact error. Keep backups and do not send private recipes unless you choose to share them.
support.zh-CN:
规划与逐批备料

在 Recipes 添加原料和自己验证的重量制配方，创建 Run 并设置目标产量及已验证批次上限。开始前检查拆批和总量；逐批称量后才确认该批原料。确认代表称好备妥，不代表已加入或混合。

中断与不确定

实际情况不明时标记 Uncertain，批次进入 Hold；物理核对后再主动解决或取消批次。重启后活动 Run 变为 Paused 并要求核对。不要仅根据 App 记录重复投料；取消量与准备完成量分别列出。

历史与文件

完成的 Run 保留配方和数量快照，Repeat 建立新 Draft 并清空确认状态。结果可导出 PDF、CSV；Settings 可导出完整 JSON 备份。整库恢复先校验并备份，再替换业务数据，不合并数据库、不恢复购买权益。请将重要备份保存到设备之外。

试用与 Lifetime

虚构 Demo 永久免费。免费非消耗型7天试用由你主动领取，从首次已验证 Apple 交易起计算7×24小时，无续费或自动扣费。美国 Lifetime 为一次性 US$19.99 非消耗型购买。到期后新的真实 Run 需 Lifetime，已有 Run 仍可完成，保存数据仍可查看和取回。在 Settings → Trial, Lifetime & Restore Purchase 购买或恢复。

范围与帮助

V1 原料使用 g/kg，产量使用 piece 或克。不换算杯数或食材密度，不读取电子秤、不提供食谱、不保证烘焙结果或认证食品安全。求助时提供版本、操作和准确错误，保留备份；除非主动决定分享，不要发送私有配方。
